items.title: File Widerspruch against the rejection of the resident parking permit
items.quote: Gegen die Ablehnung können Sie Widerspruch erheben; er muss innerhalb eines Monats, nachdem Ihnen dieser Bescheid bekannt gegeben wurde, bei der Stadt Musterbüll, Markt 1, 25899 Musterbüll, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift eingehen. Für die Bekanntgabe zählt bei Postversand der vierte Tag, nachdem der Bescheid zur Post gegeben wurde.
items.computation: Letter dated Mon 14 Jun 2027, sent by ordinary post from a German authority. The letter itself states deemed delivery on the 4th day after posting (§ 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG): Mon 14 Jun + 4 days = Fri 18 Jun 2027. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the one-month Widerspruch period (§ 70 VwGO) starts the day after delivery (19 Jun 2027) and ends one month later under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB on the day numerically corresponding to the start day: Sun 18 Jul 2027. Since that is a Sunday, § 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG shifts the deadline to the next business day: Mon 19 Jul 2027 (checked against SH public holidays, no holiday falls in between).

items.title: Submit declaration of private, permanent use of the vehicle to reopen the parking permit application
items.quote: Reichen Sie diese Erklärung nach, prüfen wir Ihren Antrag gern erneut.
items.computation: The letter invites the recipient to submit a declaration that the vehicle is used privately and permanently, so the application can be reconsidered, but it states no deadline or date by which this must happen; it is an optional, open-ended step rather than a dated obligation.

warnings: The letter's self-stated '4th day after posting' deemed-delivery rule and the one-month Widerspruch period were both applied as printed; if the letter was actually handed over or served differently, the Widerspruch deadline could differ.

No deadline is given for submitting the requested declaration about private vehicle use ('Reichen Sie diese Erklärung nach') — delay in doing so only delays a possible re-approval, it does not extend or shorten the Widerspruch deadline above.
